{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|The Jedi Council requests I perform a daunting task&hellip;.to revise the Order's historical records in light of new revelations about the formation of the Sith Empire. Specifically, I'm to trace the conflict between the Empire and the Republic, the Sith and the Jedi, to uncover the roots of the struggle which now plagues us.|Gnost-Dural|audio=Gnost-Dural2.flac|<ref name="Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref>}}
In the years following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], the [[Lore Keeper|keeper]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], created a '''series of video logs''' at the behest of the Jedi Council. Gnost-Dural was asked by the Council to trace the conflict between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to shed some light on the origins of the [[Great Galactic War|war]] between the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Kel Dor recorded his findings in these logs, which could be accessed from the Jedi Archives. Gnost-Dural created nineteen recordings, dating from as far back as the first recorded discovery of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], up to the Treaty of Coruscant itself.
